Name: Supply Alert
Description:
Warns you when your colony's food or water is approaching depletion, with independently configurable thresholds for each.

Requires Goods Statistics (by eMkaQQ) - Supply Alert reads its depletion estimates rather than recomputing its own, so Goods Statistics must be enabled too.

Settings (gear icon next to the mod in the mod list):
- Enable food alerts / Enable water alerts
- Food threshold (days) / Water threshold (days), supports decimals

You get a single warning the moment an estimate crosses at or below its threshold, and the alert re-arms once the supply recovers safely above it - no repeated spam.

Source code: https://github.com/CaseBacon/Timberborn-SupplyAlert

All credit for the underlying depletion analysis goes to eMkaQQ's Goods Statistics mod (https://github.com/eMkaQQ/timberborn-modding); this mod only adds alerting on top of it.
